title: Groups I Can See at a Glance
objective: Small groups (up to 5) can be recognized instantly, without counting one-by-one (subitizing).
studentQuestion: How do you know without counting?
newIdea: Subitizing — instant recognition of small quantities from their pattern.

teaching.setup: A dot card is shown for about 2 seconds, then hidden.
teaching.see: How many did you see? How do you know?
teaching.break: Compare the seen pattern to a known small pattern (e.g. like dice).
teaching.build: Name the quantity from the pattern, not a count.
teaching.transform: The same quantity shown in an unfamiliar arrangement — still recognized (or counted as backup) as the same amount.

check.prompt: Flip the card back over and count to confirm.

mastery.evidence: Correctly names groups of 3-5 from a brief flash on at least 4 of 5 tries.
